response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS acctscope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, order_count, CAST(order_count AS REAL) / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, CAST(order_count AS REAL) / AVG(order_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM matched

assumptions.assumption: Distinct orders are counted by orders.orderspivot (the primary key), which is equivalent to counting distinct recordvault if recordvault is unique per order.
Inner joins drop unmatched rows. Users with a NULL acctscope, if any, form their own group and count as a scope in the total and average.
The fraction and ratio are returned as unrounded floating-point values.
